title: Data Analyst - Korangi
description_html:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team based in Korangi, Karachi. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately managing employee payroll and attendance records, ensuring timely payroll processing, verifying salary-related information, and preparing detailed reports. This role requires strong attention to detail and proficiency in data handling, with a focus on maintaining accuracy and compliance. The position offers a monthly salary of PKR 60,000 and involves working on rotational shifts. Candidates must have at least an Intermediate level of education and be male.

Key Responsibilities:
- Prepare and process employee payroll accurately within set deadlines.
- Manage attendance records, including tracking overtime, leaves, and calculating salaries accordingly.
- Maintain and regularly update employee databases and payroll files.
- Verify salary deductions, allowances, and resolve any discrepancies related to attendance or payroll.
- Generate daily, weekly, and monthly reports using MS Excel to support payroll and attendance analysis.
- Analyze attendance and payroll data to ensure accuracy and adherence to company policies.

Required Qualifications:
- Minimum Intermediate education qualification.
- Proven experience in payroll preparation and processing.
- Strong understanding of attendance management systems.
- Proficiency in MS Excel and data management techniques.
- At least 1 year of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role.
- Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
- Willingness to work on rotational shifts.
- Male candidates only.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- Experience in the FMCG industry is an advantage.
- Benefits include inpatient department (IPD) medical coverage and life insurance.
- Competitive salary of up to PKR 60,000 per month.

Candidates should be prepared to work on-site in Karachi. Prior experience with manual attendance and payroll processing is highly desirable.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description_html:
Faisal Movers seeks a detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst with at least two years of experience to join their team. This role focuses on maintaining and analyzing comprehensive fleet and vehicle-related data to support operational efficiency and strategic decision-making. The analyst utilizes advanced data visualization tools and reporting techniques, primarily Microsoft Excel and Power BI, to transform complex data sets into actionable business insights. This position suits a candidate skilled in data modeling, statistical analysis, and business intelligence, with a keen interest in transportation or fleet management environments. The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for monitoring fleet performance through meticulous data consolidation and dashboard development. The role requires preparing regular analytical reports that inform management about operational trends and suggest improvements to enhance resource utilization. Although this position does not involve managing a team, the candidate works cross-functionally to support organizational goals through data-driven recommendations and process automation.
Responsibilities
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of fleet and vehicle metrics, including utilization, mileage, fuel consumption, maintenance schedules, and operational performance indicators.
  • Develop and manage advanced dashboards in Microsoft Excel for continuous fleet performance monitoring and insightful management reporting.
  • Design and implement interactive Power BI dashboards and visual reports to support real-time data analysis and strategic decision-making.
  • Consolidate data from diverse sources ensuring its accuracy, consistency, and reliability for comprehensive analysis and reporting.
  • Perform trend analysis to identify inefficiencies and potential areas for operational improvement within the fleet management process.
  • Prepare and deliver daily, weekly, and monthly analytical reports tailored to management's informational needs.
  • Automate recurring reporting tasks and streamline data processing workflows to improve efficiency and reduce errors.
  • Transform complex, raw data into clear, meaningful business insights to support data-driven decision-making and organizational success.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into effective analytic solutions.

title: SEO Analyst Intern ----- Kot Abdul Malik
description_html:
Rankdrill is seeking a motivated SEO Analyst Intern to join our team in Kot Abdul Malik. This entry-level position is ideal for fresh candidates interested in developing a career in search engine optimization and digital marketing. The intern will gain hands-on experience in keyword research, content analysis, backlink analysis, and SEO reporting, while supporting the team in executing various SEO campaigns. Candidates should have a basic understanding of SEO principles and digital marketing concepts, along with familiarity in using tools such as Google Analytics and Excel or Google Sheets. The role emphasizes learning, punctuality, communication, and the ability to follow instructions closely to deliver tasks on time. As an SEO Analyst Intern at Rankdrill, you will work under guidance, helping to collect and analyze data to optimize website content and improve search engine rankings. The role requires a proactive approach to learning new SEO techniques and staying updated with industry trends. Strong attention to detail, good communication skills, and a positive attitude are essential to succeed and grow within the digital marketing domain.

  • Analyze website content and structure to optimize on-page SEO elements.
  • Assist in backlink analysis to evaluate the quality and relevance of incoming links.
  • Compile and prepare SEO reports using tools such as Google Analytics and SEO reporting platforms.
  • Use SEO tools to monitor website performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support the SEO team by performing basic data entry and maintaining organized records in Google Sheets or MS Office.
  • Follow instructions precisely to complete assigned tasks within deadlines.
  • Stay informed about current SEO best practices and updates across search engines.
  • Communicate findings and learnings effectively with supervisors and team members.
  • Demonstrate punctuality, a willingness to learn, and a positive attitude in a fast-paced environment.

description_html:
Medical Teaching Institution Khyber Teaching Hospital, Peshawar is seeking applications for the position of Data Analyst (G-17) on a regular basis. While the advertisement primarily focuses on the basic eligibility criteria, candidates with additional experience in healthcare data analysis, familiarity with hospital information systems, or advanced skills in data visualization tools will be considered favorably. The position offers a stable, government-regular post with opportunities for professional growth within a reputable medical teaching institution.

Applicants are advised to visit the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s official jobs portal to access the detailed advertisement and application instructions. The recruitment process includes an online application followed by an ETEA test. The last date to apply is 10th November 2026. For further details, candidates should refer to the official advertisement and the ETEA website.

title: X-ray Image Analyst
company: United Human Resource Services Pvt. Ltd
description_html:
United Human Resource Services Pvt. Ltd is seeking a diligent X-ray Image Analyst with expertise in analyzing container and cargo scanner images to detect anomalies, concealments, and inconsistencies. The ideal candidate holds a bachelor's degree in Physics, Radiology, Imaging Technology, or Computer Science, or equivalent certification with relevant experience, and possesses at least two years of hands-on experience in X-ray image analysis within customs, aviation security, or logistics sectors. This role requires proficiency in using advanced image processing and AI-assisted tools to accurately interpret digital images and prepare detailed findings reports. The X-ray Image Analyst ensures compliance with prescribed standards, maintains case records, and collaborates with customs officers to support inspection and security operations effectively. This position demands high visual acuity, color vision, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to maintain focus during prolonged screen-based work. The X-ray Image Analyst independently examines scanned images, validates findings with AI outputs and cargo documentation, and escalates complex cases as necessary. Responsibilities include maintaining updated case libraries, analyzing patterns for continuous improvement, and adhering strictly to confidentiality and information-security protocols. The analyst also participates in ongoing training, proficiency testing, and quality assurance exercises to uphold accuracy and consistency. This role requires flexibility to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends. Candidates must demonstrate sound decision-making, reliability, and the ability to work effectively under pressure, ensuring compliance with the organization's conduct and performance standards.
Responsibilities
  • Examine container and cargo scanner images to identify anomalies, concealments, density/material inconsistencies, undeclared or suspicious goods, and indicators requiring further action.
  • Compare scanned images with AI analysis results, cargo manifests, and declarations to verify consistency between declared goods and scanned contents.
  • Utilize image processing and AI-assisted tools such as zoom, contrast enhancement, material discrimination, measurement, annotation, and automated alerts to validate images before finalizing findings.
  • Record clear, standardized image analysis results for each scan, distinguishing cases needing further review from those with no significant anomalies.
  • Escalate complex or uncertain images to designated supervisors or relevant review authorities for additional assessment.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of image analysis results, case references, decisions, and subsequent examination or seizure outcomes for audits and quality reviews.
  • Prepare and transmit concise official reports, discrepancy notices, referrals, alerts, and other communications to relevant customs formations according to procedures and deadlines.
  • Update and maintain a reference image and case library by adding validated cases, concealment examples, anomalies, and confirmed outcomes with proper indexing for future comparison and training.
  • Incorporate feedback from physical examinations, seizures, and supervisory reviews to update case records and enhance image interpretation accuracy.
  • Identify and report recurring concealment patterns, commodities, routes, or image analysis trends to supervisors for strategic insights.
  • Ensure confidentiality, integrity, and authorized handling of scanner images, cargo data, and analytical findings, complying with access control, data retention, and information security requirements.
  • Participate in proficiency testing, refresher training, case review sessions, and quality assurance initiatives to maintain high standards of image reading accuracy and consistency.
  • Adhere to the organization's standards regarding conduct, punctuality, and performance while performing all duties.
  • Maintain medical fitness including visual acuity and color vision suitable for prolonged screen viewing, with compliance to periodic health certifications.
  • Adapt to flexible work hours including rotating and night shifts, ensuring sustained concentration and accuracy under varying conditions.

title: CRO & UX Analyst
description_html:
We are seeking an experienced CRO & UX Analyst to join our team on a full-time, remote basis. This role requires a minimum of five years’ experience and availability to overlap with Sydney business hours, starting from 2:00 PM AEST. You will be fully integrated with our team and clients from day one, playing a crucial role in driving conversion improvements through detailed data analysis and user behavior insights. This position is not freelance or contract-based; it demands dedication, a proactive mindset, and a passion for solving complex data challenges.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct in-depth analysis using GA4 and behavioral analytics tools such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, FullStory, or Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and identify conversion barriers.
- Build custom reports, funnel and path explorations, and user segments within GA4 to pinpoint where users drop off and what drives changes in conversion rates.
- Analyze A/B test results thoroughly, breaking down data by segments and secondary metrics to explain why tests succeed or fail, and translate findings into actionable next steps.
- Review session recordings, heatmaps, and conduct heuristic evaluations to identify UX issues that impact conversions, cross-referencing insights from multiple data sources.
- Monitor data quality by detecting anomalies such as missing events or duplicates, diagnosing potential tracking issues, and collaborating with developers to resolve them.
- Leverage AI tools to automate repetitive tasks like reporting and data summarization, while ensuring all AI-generated outputs are verified for accuracy.
- Communicate complex findings clearly and effectively to both internal teams and clients, presenting insights in plain language and engaging confidently in discussions.
- Maintain a disciplined approach to double-checking all analyses and reports before sharing, and demonstrate openness to feedback and continuous learning.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 years’ hands-on experience working within GA4 or Universal Analytics, with strong expertise in building custom reports, explorations, and segments focused on conversion optimization.
- Proven track record of analyzing A/B test results and providing clear explanations of outcomes.
- Solid business acumen with the ability to interpret trends, ratios, and commercial metrics, linking site performance to revenue and other business goals.
- Regular practical experience using at least one behavioral analytics tool such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, FullStory, or Microsoft Clarity.
- Advanced proficiency in utilizing AI tools for automation and basic data analysis, coupled with a rigorous habit of validating AI outputs.
- Sufficient understanding of tracking and tagging to identify data quality issues and communicate them effectively to technical teams.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
- A curious and persistent mindset, with a can-do attitude toward solving complex data problems.
- Strong team orientation, with confidence in sharing ideas, respectfully disagreeing, and admitting knowledge gaps when necessary.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience with tracking/tagging platforms like Google Tag Manager is advantageous for troubleshooting purposes.
- Skills in Python, SQL, or BigQuery are welcome if they complement GA4 and behavioral analytics work.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team. title: Industrial Process Analyst
company: United Human Resource Services Pvt. Ltd
description_html:
United Human Resource Services Pvt. Ltd invites applications for the position of Industrial Process Analyst. The ideal candidate holds a bachelor's or master's degree in engineering disciplines such as Mechanical, Chemical, Textile, or related fields and has at least three years of relevant industrial sector experience. This role requires a detail-oriented analyst capable of verifying industry claims related to raw material consumption and finished goods output and supporting customs authorities in evaluating duty exemptions and export-related incentive schemes. The Industrial Process Analyst contributes to maintaining accurate input-output norms for industries, assisting in customs decision-making processes, and ensuring compliance with public service and government regulations. The selected candidate will be responsible for conducting industrial site audits, plant process evaluations, and sectoral studies to establish efficiency and yield benchmarks. Strong data analysis, documentation, and presentation skills are crucial to prepare comprehensive technical reports and recommendations that support customs policies. This position demands a professional with an analytical and investigative mindset who can work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders, including trade associations and customs staff. Although this role does not require managing a team, the candidate must demonstrate commitment to integrity, critical thinking, and collaborative engagement.
Responsibilities
  • Assist the Collectorate in verifying industry claims regarding raw material consumption and finished goods production, ensuring accuracy aligned with actual manufacturing processes.
  • Support the assessment of applications related to duty exemptions and export facilitation incentive schemes by analyzing input-output data.
  • Conduct detailed sectoral studies to establish standard input-output ratios and production norms for industries eligible for customs concessions and export schemes.
  • Perform field visits and plant inspections to observe, evaluate, and document industrial processes and material efficiency practices.
  • Engage with stakeholders including industry representatives and trade associations to gather insights and validate findings.
  • Provide informed expert opinions and technical support during investigations, audits, and decision-making processes concerning customs duties and input-output evaluations.
  • Maintain and periodically update a reliable database of sector-specific input-output norms to assist in customs operations and policy development.
  • Prepare clear, data-driven technical reports, case notes, and recommendations to inform customs policy formulation and improve duty drawback methodologies.
  • Assist in the determination and periodic review of duty drawback rates by analyzing production costs and efficiency metrics.
  • Deliver training sessions and provide ongoing technical support to customs staff to enhance their understanding of industrial processes and input-output analysis.
  • Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams to meet organizational objectives and uphold government compliance and public service standards.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned by the Collector as part of maintaining robust industrial customs processes.

title: Operations & Data Analyst / Advanced Excel Specialist
description_html:
Join the Amanah Group of Companies as an Operations & Data Analyst / Advanced Excel Specialist based in Lahore. This role demands a highly analytical individual with advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel to support and enhance the billing and shipment reconciliation functions. The position requires meticulous handling of large datasets from various courier partners such as UPS and DPD, applying pricing matrices, calculating profit margins, and ensuring invoicing accuracy to prevent revenue leakage. The candidate will operate from the Amanah Mall office during afternoon and evening hours, focusing on detail-oriented tasks to maintain data integrity and financial accuracy. The ideal candidate must excel in processing complex Excel functions, master the reconciliation of manifests against courier invoices, and prepare detailed reports to highlight billing statuses and discrepancies. Strong numerical skills along with a thorough understanding of cost calculations and margin analysis are essential. Although the role does not involve managing a team, it requires effective collaboration with the operations team to resolve discrepancies and streamline billing processes. This position plays a critical role in safeguarding the companys revenue through diligent data analysis and operational vigilance.
Responsibilities
  • Process, clean, organize, and format raw Excel data files received from courier and logistics partners ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  • Apply prescribed pricing matrices and courier costs to shipments, accurately calculating profit margins to support financial analysis.
  • Merge, reconcile, and audit multiple courier invoices and reports into structured datasets to maintain accurate billing records.
  • Maintain a centralized Master Excel Sheet tracking all customer-submitted shipment manifests and reconcile these against courier invoices.
  • Identify and track billed versus unbilled shipments to guarantee all customer orders are invoiced correctly and documented.
  • Audit manifests and shipment data to detect discrepancies such as missing invoices, incorrect charges, or rate mismatches.
  • Investigate and coordinate with operations teams to resolve billing discrepancies, ensuring no shipment remains unbilled.
  • Compile and deliver daily and weekly reports detailing billing status, shipment reconciliation outcomes, profit margins, and any identified anomalies.
  • Ensure meticulous record keeping to support data integrity and ease of management review.
  • Apply advanced Excel skills including VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, and nested IF statements for complex data manipulation and analysis.
  • Utilize data validation, cleaning, and reconciliation techniques proficiently to manage large and multifaceted datasets.
  • Employ numerical and analytical skills to interpret percentages, cost calculations, and margin monitoring to optimize revenue protection.
  • Communicate effectively in written and operational English to document processes, discrepancies, and collaborate with internal teams.
  • Adhere to office timings and maintain consistent work attendance and discipline in an on-site environment.

title: Data Analyst – Customer Support
description_html:
Nysonian is seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our Customer Support team in Islamabad. This full-time, in-person role operates from 6 pm to 2 am PKT and focuses on delivering reliable reporting, insightful dashboards, and actionable analysis to enhance customer support operations. The ideal candidate will work with complex datasets to monitor performance, identify operational challenges, and recommend improvements that boost customer experience and team efficiency. Attention to detail, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment are essential.

Key Responsibilities
- Translate business questions from Customer Support stakeholders into clear analytical requirements, metric definitions, and reporting deliverables.
- Extract, clean, combine, and analyze large datasets from various support systems, databases, and spreadsheets.
- Build and maintain dashboards using visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
- Monitor key support metrics including ticket volume, backlog, first response time, resolution time, SLA compliance, reopen rate, CSAT, and agent productivity.
- Analyze customer complaints, repeat contacts, returns, refunds, retention outcomes, and chargeback reasons to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
- Evaluate human and AI support performance, considering case complexity, communication channels, and workload.
- Investigate discrepancies between reports and source data, document root causes, and coordinate with relevant teams for corrections.
- Automate recurring reports and data preparation tasks to improve efficiency and consistency.
- Perform data quality checks for missing records, duplicates, inconsistent identifiers, date issues, and calculation errors, presenting findings with clear recommendations.
- Maintain thorough documentation of reporting logic, business definitions, assumptions, and limitations.
- Handle customer and business information responsibly, adhering to company data access policies.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or operational reporting (internships and academic projects should be listed separately).
- Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related analytical field.
- Minimum CGPA of 3.2 out of 4.0 or equivalent in the most recent degree.
- Strong practical SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and date-based analysis.
- Hands-on experience working with large datasets, including querying, cleaning, combining, and validating data efficiently.
- Proficiency in at least one visualization tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
- Working knowledge of Python, particularly pandas, for data preparation, analysis, and automation.
- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookup formulas, data validation, and reconciliation.
- Ability to select appropriate analytical methods, calculate rates and averages accurately, and distinguish meaningful changes from misleading comparisons.
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues beyond surface-level metrics.
- Capability to manage multiple requests, reprioritize quickly, communicate timelines clearly, and maintain accuracy under tight deadlines.
- Ability to work independently with incomplete requirements while clarifying key assumptions.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Experience in Customer Support, customer experience, contact center, or e-commerce analytics.
- Familiarity with ticket-level, customer-level, order-level, or interaction-level data analysis.
- Knowledge of CRM or helpdesk platforms and support workflows.
- Exposure to PostgreSQL, MongoDB, APIs, or JSON data formats.
- Experience with cohort analysis, customer retention, refunds, returns, or chargebacks.
- Skills in optimizing slow queries and handling datasets too large for standard spreadsheets.

Why You’ll Love Working at Nysonian
We are a founder-led company that values speed, direct communication, and clear accountability. Our culture encourages thoughtful innovation and ownership, supported by tools and management practices that enable employees to excel. Our products reach customers worldwide, and AI is embedded in how we work and scale. Senior leaders focus on creating structure, making decisions, and staying close to execution.

We offer competitive pay with meaningful performance-based advancement opportunities. Employees gain ownership of strategy, systems, execution, and team development within their functions. There is significant scope for growth tied to performance, role expansion, and measurable business impact.

Nysonian is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, sex, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other protected characteristics.
